pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sitting Beneath a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn sitting beneath a rainbow, with a spiral horn, flowing mane, and curled tail above grassy ground. Broad rainbow bands and rounded clouds sit behind the unicorn, while small grass tufts add scattered details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sleeping in the Curve of a Crescent Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sleeps in the curve of a crescent moon in this printable coloring page, resting its head on folded forehooves beneath scattered stars. Long waves divide the mane and tail into separate sections, contrasting with the broad moon shape and small circles across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Winged Unicorn Flying Above Puffy Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii winged unicorn flies above puffy clouds in this printable coloring page, spreading its feathered wings while stars surround its raised forehooves. Layered feathers and sweeping hair sections provide smaller areas within the coloring sheet, and rounded cloud shapes fill the lower edge beneath the floating unicorn.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Face with a Daisy Crown and Curled Mane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii unicorn face framed by a daisy crown and curled mane, with pointed ears and a tall spiral horn. Five flowers with round centers cross the forehead, and small leaves sit between the petals. The coloring sheet pairs broad facial areas with narrower curls and floral details.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Cuddling a Smiling Star Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn cuddles a smiling star in this printable coloring page, wrapping both forehooves around its points as hearts and smaller stars surround them. The star has closed eyes and oval cheeks, while the unicorn has a long curled mane and tail. These flowing sections contrast with the simple shapes scattered across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Riding a Fluffy Cloud Beside a Shooting Star Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn riding a fluffy cloud beside a shooting star, looking upward with one foreleg lifted and its mouth open. The smiling star trails several broad curved bands above the unicorn. Smaller stars and clouds surround the central pair, with separate mane and tail sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Peeking Through a Sprinkled Doughnut Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn peeks through a sprinkled doughnut in this printable coloring page, resting its forehooves on the lower edge of the large frosted ring. Rounded sprinkles and small dots decorate the wavy icing, while the unicorn’s hind hooves and curled tail remain visible below. The coloring sheet has a plain background around the central design.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Resting Its Forehooves on a Giant Cupcake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a kawaii unicorn resting its forehooves on a giant cupcake, with a cherry above swirled frosting decorated with hearts and sprinkles. Vertical pleats divide the cupcake wrapper into narrow panels, while the unicorn’s wavy mane and curled tail create broader flowing sections beside the dessert on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Licking an Ice Cream Cone Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn licks an ice cream cone in this printable coloring page, holding it with one forehoof beneath a scoop covered in small sprinkles. Its tongue touches the scoop beside a smiling muzzle, and a crosshatched cone adds small geometric spaces. The coloring sheet leaves broad open areas across the seated unicorn’s body.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sipping Bubble Tea Through a Straw Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn sipping bubble tea through a wide straw, holding a domed cup between its forehooves while sitting upright. Round pearls cluster near the bottom of the drink, and oval cheek markings frame the unicorn’s smile. Sweeping mane and tail sections add larger shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Blowing a Bubble Gum Bubble Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn blows a bubble gum bubble in this printable coloring page, sitting with straight forelegs as the large round bubble extends beside its muzzle. Two outlined highlight shapes decorate the bubble, while a spiral horn and long curling mane rise above it. The coloring sheet keeps the background clear around the unicorn’s silhouette.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Licking a Swirled Lollipop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn licking a swirled lollipop, with a raised forehoof, large eyes, and a long curled mane. The spiral candy and striped horn add smaller sections to the coloring sheet, while the seated body and sweeping tail provide broad open spaces.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Baking Star-shaped Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn bakes star-shaped cookies in this printable coloring page, stirring a mixing bowl beside a baking tray and a star cutter. Jars, a whisk, an oven mitt, and an arched window fill the kitchen behind it. The coloring sheet combines wide areas on the unicorn and table with smaller utensil and cookie details.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Having a Tea Party with a Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii unicorn having a tea party with a bunny, each holding a cup beside a heart-decorated teapot. Cookies and a cupcake sit on their round table, with matching scalloped trim on the tablecloth and stools. The coloring sheet includes open body shapes, flowing mane sections, and smaller treats and heart motifs.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in a Party Hat Beside a Birthday Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn wears a spotted party hat beside a birthday cake in this printable coloring page, surrounded by floating hearts and stars. Three striped candles rise above the cake's dripping icing, dotted decoration, and rounded border. Broad body and cake areas contrast with the smaller hat spots and flame shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Popping Out of a Gift Box Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn popping out of an open gift box, resting its forehooves above a large ribbon and bow. The smiling face and curled mane fill the upper half, while folded box flaps surround the unicorn. Wide box panels and ribbon loops give this coloring sheet large sections alongside the horn and hair details.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Beside a Bunch of Heart-shaped Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn stands beside a bunch of heart-shaped balloons in this printable coloring page, with curling hair, a striped horn, and a smiling face. Four balloons rise on long strings tied with a bow above a small weight. Their broad hearts and the unicorn's open body shapes keep the coloring sheet spacious, with narrower sections along the mane and tail.

pages.title: Two Kawaii Unicorn Friends Touching Noses Beneath a Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features two kawaii unicorn friends touching noses beneath a large heart, with matching striped horns, wavy manes, and curled tails. The pair face each other in the center, their hooves aligned along the bottom. Repeated hair sections and broad body shapes create a balanced coloring sheet with one open heart above their heads.

pages.title: Kawaii Mother Unicorn Nuzzling Her Foal Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii mother unicorn nuzzles her seated foal in this printable coloring page, both with closed eyes, small smiles, flowing manes, and striped horns. The larger unicorn bends her head toward the foal, whose curled tail extends beside its body. This coloring sheet leaves the background clear, keeping attention on their touching faces and layered hair sections.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Hugging a Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn hugging a teddy bear, with closed smiling eyes, a sweeping mane, and its forehooves wrapped around the toy. Both figures sit with rounded feet facing forward, and the bear has outlined ears, a muzzle, and oval paw pads. The coloring sheet offers broad body spaces framed by smaller hair and face details.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Watching a Butterfly Land on Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn watches a butterfly land on its nose in this printable coloring page, standing among small flowers and scattered tufts of grass. The butterfly has outlined wing patterns, while the unicorn's long mane and tail form broad curling sections. This coloring sheet pairs a large open body with smaller petals, antennae, and wing shapes.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Giving a Kitten a Ride on Its Back Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii unicorn giving a kitten a ride on its back, with a curled mane, striped horn, and sweeping tail. The kitten sits upright with its front paws together, pointed ears, whiskers, and a raised curved tail. Large unicorn shapes fill most of the coloring sheet, balanced by the kitten's smaller face and paw details.

pages.title: Kawaii Mermaid Unicorn Swimming Beside a Seashell Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii mermaid unicorn swimming beside an open seashell, with a scaled tail, flowing mane, and bubbles around its head. A round pearl rests inside the shell, while the coloring sheet combines small overlapping scales with larger spaces in the mane, fins, and shell.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Beside a Fairy Sitting on a Toadstool Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a kawaii unicorn sits beside a fairy on a spotted toadstool, with both characters facing each other and smiling. The fairy has butterfly-shaped wings, a flower in her hair, and a petal skirt; the coloring sheet also includes small flowers and tufts of grass.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Nuzzling a Little Princess in a Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii unicorn nuzzling a little princess in a crown, their eyes closed as her hands rest on her gown. Heart decorations appear on the crown and bodice, while broad skirt panels and long curls give the coloring sheet a mix of large and narrow spaces.

pages.title: Kawaii Princess Unicorn Wearing a Tiara Beside a Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii princess unicorn wears a heart-decorated tiara beside a castle in this printable coloring page, with a long mane and curled tail framing its body. Three flag-topped towers rise behind the unicorn, and a winding path leads to the arched doors; the coloring sheet keeps the foreground mostly open.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Meeting a Friendly Knight at a Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn meeting a friendly knight at a castle gate, with the smiling knight wearing a plumed helmet and cape. The unicorn stands beside the knight on a stone path, while armor panels, tower windows, and gate blocks add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Following Fireflies Along a Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a kawaii unicorn follows three smiling fireflies along a forest path, lifting one forehoof while looking toward the flying insects. Tall tree trunks border the scene, and scattered stones curve into the distance; the coloring sheet includes broad mane sections, leaves, and small grass tufts.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Drinking From a Stream Below a Small Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a kawaii unicorn drinking from a stream below a small waterfall, with its lowered muzzle touching rings on the water. Rounded rocks and bushes surround the bank, while the long mane hangs beside the face; the coloring sheet has flowing water contours and broad rock surfaces.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Watering a Pot of Daisies Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn waters a pot of daisies in this printable coloring page, tilting a small watering can above three flowers with rounded petals and leaves. The seated unicorn has a sweeping mane and curled tail, and the coloring sheet contrasts the large flowerpot and body spaces with smaller petals and droplets.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Wearing Round Glasses and Reading a Book Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii unicorn wearing round glasses and reading an open book, seated with both forehooves holding the covers in front. Oversized circular frames surround its eyes, while the curled mane and tail provide flowing sections around the broad book covers and hooves on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Painting a Rainbow on an Easel Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a kawaii unicorn paints a rainbow on an easel, holding a brush near the curved bands and a palette below. Puffy clouds sit at both ends of the rainbow, while the coloring sheet provides wide mane sections, a plain canvas background, and small outlined paint spots.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Dancing Beneath a Disco Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn dancing beneath a disco ball, raising both forehooves and one hind hoof above a round patterned dance floor. Star-shaped sparkles and circles surround the unicorn, while the coloring sheet pairs broad body and mane spaces with the small grid sections of the disco ball.

pages.title: Kawaii Superhero Unicorn Wearing a Mask and Cape Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii superhero unicorn standing in an eye mask and flowing cape, with a spiral horn and long curled mane. A round clasp fastens the cape, while the coloring sheet combines broad body areas with narrow hair sections and the horn's curved bands.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sitting on a Garden Swing Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sits on a garden swing in this printable coloring page, holding twisted ropes beneath a leafy branch with flowers growing below. The wooden seat supports its dangling hooves, and its long tail curls beside the ropes. This coloring sheet includes small petals and leaves around the larger unicorn shapes.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Riding in a Hot Air Balloon Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn riding in a hot air balloon basket, with its forehooves over the rim and clouds alongside. Hearts decorate the balloon's draped trim above the unicorn's spiral horn. Wide balloon panels and a basket weave give this coloring sheet a mix of large and small sections.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Rolling a Beach Ball with Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn rolls a beach ball with its nose in this printable coloring page, standing on sand with small waves visible behind it. A seashell and scattered pebbles sit near its hooves. The ball's curved panels form large coloring areas, while the coloring sheet adds narrower sections in the unicorn's curled mane and tail.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Relaxing in a Bubble Bath Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii unicorn relaxing in a bubble bath, resting both forehooves on the tub's rim as bubbles float around its horn. Rounded foam shapes surround its long mane, and curved feet support the bathtub. The coloring sheet leaves a large open tub panel beneath the smaller bubbles and hair sections.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Roasting a Marshmallow Beside a Campfire Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn roasts a marshmallow beside a campfire in this printable coloring page, holding a long stick above flames surrounded by a stone ring. Logs, grass tufts, and distant pine trees complete the campsite. This coloring sheet pairs broad unicorn shapes with smaller details in the firewood, stones, and curling mane.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Carrying a Valentine Envelope in Its Mouth Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn carrying a Valentine envelope in its mouth, with a heart seal, spiral horn, and long curled mane. The unicorn stands against a plain background, keeping the envelope clearly visible. Broad body areas and curved hair sections make up most of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in Bunny Ears Beside an Easter Egg Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn wears bunny ears beside an Easter egg basket in this printable coloring page, with a curled tail and small flowers near its hooves. A large bow decorates the woven basket, which holds striped, dotted, and zigzag eggs. This coloring sheet combines open unicorn shapes with smaller seasonal patterns.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Trick-or-treating with a Pumpkin Pail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii unicorn trick-or-treating with a pumpkin pail, lifting one forehoof to carry candy above scattered autumn leaves on the ground. The pail has triangular eyes and a toothy grin, with a swirled sweet among the treats. Smaller candy and leaf details accompany the unicorn's broad shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Wearing a Santa Hat Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn wears a Santa hat beside a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, with round ornaments and wrapped presents beneath the branches. Beaded garlands curve across the tree below a star topper. The coloring sheet includes small bows and ornament sections alongside the unicorn's open body areas and flowing tail.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Gliding on Ice Skates Across a Frozen Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a kawaii unicorn gliding across a frozen pond on ice skates, raising its forelegs with snowy pine trees behind it. Bows decorate the skates, and curved marks trace its path across the ice. The coloring sheet combines broad snowy areas with flowing mane sections and small skate details.
